# Wave 8
Status: Inbox

# Wave 8: Recovery bake and v1.00.30 release

Depends on: W7 merged and bound; complete cohorts, R2, guard and all safety gates PASS
Contract: `.planning/PLAN-v1.00.30-PR-CI-RECOVERY.md` (all delivery, sampling, safety and rollback rules apply).
Source: `.planning/q-v1.00.29-pr-ci-regression-assessment.md`.
Branch: `campaign/v1.00.30-w8`; issue ID to be provisioned by coordinator, never invented.

## Goal

Bake the measured recovery, preserve the exact W7 verdict and publish only through protected main and the standard verified release pipeline.

## Tasks

1. Bump version to 1.00.30 via canonical version/sync tooling; derive test expectations from q-version. Add CHANGELOG entry with exact W7 verdict and artifact-bound claims, not an affirmative performance headline unless R4 passed. Sync README/status/document version markers. Discover and regenerate any current-version ownership/wait-audit/overlap bake artifacts required by existing runtime-contract tests (do not invent results or copy old timings as new).
2. Bake current-source/mismatch/root-hit/fallback and all required suites on exact release content, verify full required-claim inventory and no hidden failure. Format/compile changed Racket, check release notes, metrics, version expectations and local release bundle. Preserve self-contained schema-2 review/validation records; no dangling citations or promised future green runs.
3. Coordinator delivers protected PR, binds merge SHA, waits for latest-main CI green, then re-records fast/tui/arch/workflows gate evidence on clean main at the actual intended tag SHA. Run strict tag-publish readiness and ALL release-preflight gates, tag annotated v1.00.30, authorize environment review using the real environment ID only if permitted, and verify public non-draft release, manifest/checksums/provenance/install smoke and verify-public success. No tag from feature branch, premature milestone closure or direct deployment-status success fabrication.

- File: q/util/version.rkt
- File: q/info.rkt
- File: q/CHANGELOG.md
- File: q/README.md
- File: q/scripts/lint-release-notes.rkt
- File: q/tests/test-lint-release-notes.rkt
- File: q/tests/test-ci-runtime-contract.rkt
- File: q/docs/reports/PR-CI-RECOVERY-RELEASE-v1.00.30.md
- File: q/docs/architecture/overview.md
- File: q/artifacts/ci-recovery/v1.00.30-release/bake.json
- File: q/artifacts/ci-recovery/v1.00.30-release/SHA256SUMS

- File: q/docs/reports/gsd-wave-reviews/v1.00.30-w8.rktd
- File: q/docs/reports/gsd-wave-validation/v1.00.30-w8.rktd

## Supporting scope and evidence

Named files above are concrete implementation/evidence targets, not permission for unrelated refactors. Raw API and artifact inputs live under `raw/` in `q/artifacts/ci-recovery/v1.00.30-release`; retain SHA256SUMS, no secrets. Common incidental scope: canonical tier-ownership matrix and its checksums if new tests require regeneration; README metrics; test dependency inventory if the declared modules add imports. Version-marker/generated bake surfaces in W8 follow canonical generators only. New files listed here are intentional deliverables, not claimed to exist already. Resolve actual existing test/module seams at launch; if scope needs a material change, stop for a reviewed plan amendment before snapshot freeze/execution, never silently rewrite frozen wave docs.

Before each production Racket edit ensure regression tests exist and fail for the right reason. Format and compile every changed Racket source with `raco fmt -i` and `raco make` before the verification chain. Keep offline test fixtures deterministic. Commands below run at the dedicated worktree git root. Metrics must use that same tree (if tooling assumes a `q/` basename, prepare an appropriate dedicated worktree path, never measure a different checkout).

## Acceptance and coordinator gates

Exact W7 verdict preserved; release allowed only under PLAN release policy. This wave remains pending delivery until public assets and release pipeline verified, latest-main CI green, all merge bindings exist and milestone/board are consistent. Repair missing bake surfaces before claiming completion. Unknown/missing release proof is a hard stop.

All required checks plus artifact/job truth are necessary, not sufficient. Coordinator enforces the applicable PR latency sample gate on the exact final head, independent APPROVED review, protected squash merge and merge-SHA binding before advancing. Missing remote evidence means HOLD. Local Verify has no authority to waive R0/R1/R2, protection, sample size or release gates. Never mark this wave complete while a cohort is open or delivery is pending.

```bash
racket scripts/check-version-expectations.rkt && raco test tests/test-lint-release-notes.rkt tests/test-ci-runtime-contract.rkt && racket scripts/lint-release-notes.rkt --check && racket scripts/sync-readme-status.rkt --check && racket scripts/release-dry-run.rkt && racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite arch && racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite security && racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite tui && racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite workflows && racket scripts/check-deps.rkt && racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite fast && racket scripts/metrics.rkt --lint
```

- Done: Declared implementation/report artifacts are committed; all local checks pass on the exact wave content with completed RUN-SUMMARY retained.
- Done: Acceptance and coordinator gates above satisfied; schema-2 evidence/review/validation accepted by gsd-wave-gate, genuine independent review APPROVED, required checks and applicable latency guard PASS.
- Done: Protected wave PR squash-merged, evidence bound to actual merge SHA through the campaign binding protocol, issue/board updated only after all gates; next wave entry explicitly authorized. W8 additionally requires public release verification before closure.

Inbox; implementation has not started. Coordinator launch report: `.planning/v1.00.30-launch-preflight/REPORT.md`. Do not start before launch holds are resolved. Do not close on a local commit, open cohort or unbound delivery.
